prompt.notes: Useful long-context target below the exact artifact's upstream-tested ceiling.

output_reserve.notes: Reserved even though deterministic probes should terminate earlier.

concurrency.notes: A later campaign may evaluate NInfer's bounded C2-C8 serving.

variable.notes: The incumbent managed serve will be unloaded before candidate start.

variable.source: NInfer current resource-sizing contract for --kv-capacity auto
variable.notes: The default campaign reserve is 3 GiB; this isolated model-only trial uses NInfer's 1 GiB automatic sizing reserve and requires local post-workload telemetry.

min_deterministic_pass_rate.notes: Identity, visible answer, retrieval, and tool assertions may not be averaged down.

max_relative_quality_loss.notes: Compared with retained higher-fidelity or incumbent evidence only when protocols match.

min_warm_e2e_gain.notes: MTP3 must improve matched warm end-to-end latency by at least 10 percent versus no speculation.

min_tasks_per_hour_ratio.notes: No regression is allowed when a comparable task-level measure exists.

reserve_policy_change.scope: one isolated model-only RTX 5090 candidate at concurrency one
reserve_policy_change.rationale: The engine's automatic KV sizing preserves 1 GiB; promotion remains forbidden and local startup plus post-representative-workload telemetry is mandatory.

runtime_context_limit_tokens.notes: Logical model ceiling; actual KV capacity remains a startup result.

measured_max_stable_context_tokens.source: official exact-artifact evaluation on one RTX 5090 at 252,928 tokens
measured_max_stable_context_tokens.notes: Same GPU product and artifact, different host; local stability is not yet measured.

target_checkpoint_bytes.notes: Logical checkpoint bytes, not GPU allocation.

runtime_fixed_mtp_graphs_and_sequence_st.source: same-GPU operating envelope after reserving the exact checkpoint, a conservative 16 KiB/token KV upper bound, and NInfer's confirmed 1 GiB auto-sizing headroom
runtime_fixed_mtp_graphs_and_sequence_st.notes: Paper bound only; runtime fixed, graphs, proposal head, recurrent state, and sequence state must be narrowed after local startup evidence.

target_and_mtp_kv.source: registered Qwen3.8 hybrid-attention geometry with INT8 group-64 KV; BF16-equivalent ceiling retained as a conservative bound
target_and_mtp_kv.notes: Includes target and MTP KV planning allowance; local startup logs must replace this interval.

kv_token_multiplier.notes: NInfer uses one shared main-text KV pool at concurrency one.

quality_score.notes: Official scores are external priors and are not a local matched metric.

reference_quality_score.notes: No protocol-matched local reference selected yet.

no_spec_warm_e2e_seconds.notes: Requires the matched local no-speculation arm.

successful_tasks_per_hour.notes: Not measured by the first compatibility pass.

reference_tasks_per_hour.notes: Not measured by the first compatibility pass.
